int f_dp[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE], g_dp[MAX_SIZE][MAX_SIZE];

int main() {
    scanf("%d %d %d", &nodes, &edges, &mod);
    
    // Compute binomial coefficients
    for (int i = 0; i <= nodes; ++i) {
        comb[i][0] = 1;
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            comb[i][j] = (comb[i-1][j-1] + comb[i-1][j]) % mod;
        }
    }
    
    // Single tree calculations
    f_single[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; ++i) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            long long term = (long long)f_single[j-1] * f_single[i-j] % mod;
            term = term * comb[i-1][j-1] % mod;
            f_single[i] = (f_single[i] + term) % mod;
            
            long long cross = ((long long)f_single[j-1] * g_single[i-j] + 
                              (long long)g_single[j-1] * f_single[i-j]) % mod;
            cross = cross * (i + 1) % mod;
            
            long long base = (long long)f_single[j-1] * f_single[i-j] % mod;
            base = base * (comb[j][2] + comb[i-j+1][2]) % mod;
            
            long long add = (base + cross) % mod;
            add = add * comb[i-1][j-1] % mod;
            
            g_single[i] = (g_single[i] + add) % mod;
        }
        f_single[i] = (long long)(i + 1) * f_single[i] % mod;
    }
    
    // DP initialization
    f_dp[0][0] = 1;
    
    // DP computation
    for (int i = 1; i <= nodes; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= min(i, edges); ++j) {
            f_dp[i][j] = f_dp[i-1][j];
            g_dp[i][j] = g_dp[i-1][j];
            
            for (int k = 1; k <= j; ++k) {
                int prev_f = (i - k) ? f_dp[i-k-1][j-k] : 1;
                int prev_g = (i - k) ? g_dp[i-k-1][j-k] : 0;
                
                long long term_f = (long long)prev_f * f_single[k] % mod;
                term_f = term_f * comb[j][k] % mod;
                f_dp[i][j] = (f_dp[i][j] + term_f) % mod;
                
                long long term_g = ((long long)prev_f * g_single[k] + 
                                   (long long)prev_g * f_single[k]) % mod;
                term_g = term_g * comb[j][k] % mod;
                g_dp[i][j] = (g_dp[i][j] + term_g) % mod;
            }
